name: Jolene
description: Sweet and shy, Jolene needs a patient, calm home where she can build confidence at her own pace. Good with kids and dogs; likely okay with cats.

name: Vex
description: A super-social little guy who loves making friends! Vex is ready to bring plenty of puppy personality to his forever home.

name: Calypso
description: A super-social sweetheart who loves people and other dogs. Calypso is crate trained and housebroken, and ready for a family of her own.

name: Cheeto
description: A little shy at first, Cheeto warms up with time. He is good with people and dogs, housebroken and crate trained. He needs a home without small animals.

name: Ringo
description: Ringo is a friendly, growing boy who enjoys people and other dogs. This large-breed puppy is looking for a loving family ready for all the fun and learning that comes with raising a pup.

name: Mojo
description: Mojo is a 7-month-old boy who loves people and other dogs. He's working on crate training and housebreaking, and will need a family ready to continue helping him learn. His compatibility with cats is unknown.

name: Tallulah
description: Tallulah is a friendly young Doberman mix who does well with people and other dogs. She's a large-breed puppy looking for a family to grow up with. Her compatibility with cats is unknown.

name: Wafer
breed: German Shepherd / Australian Shepherd / Golden Retriever mix
description: Wafer is a one-year-old girl who is housebroken and crate trained. She does well with people and other dogs. Her compatibility with cats is unknown.

name: Taki
description: Taki is a small-to-medium-sized Carolina Dog who can be shy at first but warms up quickly. He's crate trained and good with people and other dogs; likely okay with cats.

name: Claire (Honey)
description: Honey loves walks and enjoys people and other dogs with slow, thoughtful introductions. She needs a home without cats.

name: Abracadabra (Abby)
description: Abby is a super-outgoing, bouncy little girl who loves everyone! She's social with people and other animals, and is working on crate training and housebreaking. Her enthusiastic bouncing in an exercise pen might not be ideal for a home with downstairs neighbors. She's looking for a family ready to enjoy her big personality and continue her training.

name: Pocus
description: Pocus is a sweet, social little girl who enjoys people and other dogs! Cats are untested, though she may do well with them. She's still working on housebreaking and can be vocal when left alone in her crate, so she'll appreciate a patient family who can help her build confidence with alone time.

name: Hocus
description: Hocus can be a little shy when meeting new people, but he warms up quickly. He loves other dogs and truly thrives with their companionship. He's working on housebreaking and crate training, and may do well with cats, though that hasn't been confirmed. Hocus would love a patient family and a canine friend to help him feel at home.

name: Hoodoo
description: Hoodoo is a sweet, social girl who gets along with people, dogs, and cats! She walks nicely on a leash and knows to potty while on leash, though she can get distracted outdoors and occasionally has accidents inside. Crate training is still a work in progress. This 7-month-old pup is looking for a family to keep encouraging her as she learns and grows.
